senses.en_definition: But; however; used to introduce a contrast or qualification.

collocations.en: want to go but don't have time

messages.en: Let's have dinner tonight. Can you make it at eight?
I'd love to join you, but I haven't finished my work yet. Would nine work?
Sure, no problem. Message me when you're done.
Have you watched that dance video from earlier?
Yeah, it was beautiful! I want to watch it again.

senses.en_definition: To pull or drag something towards oneself or in a particular direction.

collocations.en: pull a rope; tug of war

senses.en_definition: To breathe in; to inhale (in the phrase tarik nafas).
To take back, retract or recall (with balik); to withdraw from an activity or position (with diri).
To attract someone's attention or arouse their interest (with perhatian or minat).

messages.en: Where should this table go? Can I just pull it over to the side?
Don't pull it on your own. It's heavy! Wait till I get there.
Have you checked the date of our appointment at the clinic?
Yeah, it's November 12. Let me put it in my calendar.
